# Dropdown Menu

Menu opened from a button (role=menu). Supports labels, groups, checkbox and radio items, shortcuts, submenus and a destructive variant; arrow keys and typeahead move between items.

## Import

```tsx
import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuCheckboxItem, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuGroup, … } from "@cesuain/ui";
// or the per-component entry point
import { DropdownMenu } from "@cesuain/ui/dropdown-menu";
```

## Accessibility

- Behaviour and semantics are summarized above; keyboard and screen reader behaviour follow the WAI-ARIA pattern of the underlying primitive.
- `dropdown-menu.test.tsx` covers rendering, variants and interaction with Testing Library and runs axe-core on the rendered output (contrast is checked at token level). Every story also runs axe-core's default rule set in the Storybook browser tests; violations fail the run.
- Colors come from semantic tokens whose contrast is checked in both themes by `pnpm tokens:check`.
